title: Working at Citi: What are some of the benefits of working at Citi?
description: Analysts and Associates across our Global Consumer Bank share their experiences on the most exciting aspect of working at Citi.  Citi Careers: http://careers.citi.com/  View other Citi videos: http://www.youtube.com/citi Read our Blog: http://blog.citigroup.com Like us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/citi Follow us on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/citi Follow us on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/citi Follow us on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/citi Follow us on Google+: http://www.google.com/+citi

asr.full_text: MUSIC VIRGINIA KERNLEY A huge benefit of working at Citi is the collaboration across all business segments and we're constantly utilizing each other's resources. CITI BELAIR We all work at a global bank and, as employees, we have access to unlimited knowledge and best practices shared by our colleagues around the world. DAVE LAGARA You get free admission to many of the museums in New York City. There's so much to see and do at the museums in the city that this is definitely one of my favorite parts and one that I've definitely taken advantage of. I think you can get a lot of exposure to different parts of the business. You can always find someone new to meet, someone new to learn from. There's always a new project going on or just and when you to learn from there's always a new project going on or just a new strategy to learn about
